guideContent.strategyOverview:
Zada, Hedron Grinder is a {3}{R} 3/3 Legendary Goblin Ally whose trigger copies any single-target instant or sorcery for each other creature you control. The deck weaponizes this in three overlapping themes the board asked for: storm, spellslinger, and goblin tribal.

The goblin engine is built on token producers (Krenko, Pashalik, Mogg War Marshal, Siege-Gang Commander, Siege-Gang Lieutenant, Searslicer Goblin, General Kreat, Krenko's Command, Empty the Warrens) layered with three goblin lords (Goblin Chieftain, Goblin Warchief, Rundvelt Hordemaster) that grant +1/+1 and haste. Skirk Prospector converts goblins into red mana for ritual chains. Goblin Bombardment provides a free repeatable sac outlet (also a kill line, see below).

The spellslinger / Zada-cantrip suite is seven cheap single-target effects that each draw a card or are functional cantrips: Expedite, Crimson Wisps, Renegade Tactics, Fists of Flame, Ancestral Anger, Wild Ride (harmonize for replay), and Ancestors' Aid (which creates a Treasure per copy — turning Zada into a ramp engine for the storm chain). Naktamun Lorespinner // Wheel of Fortune (prepared variant, owned) provides a hardcast Wheel of Fortune slot inside the cards-permitted-by-the-board's exclusion list. Faithless Looting + Witch's Mark + Skullclamp + Idol of Oblivion + Bedlam Reveler ETB-draw-3 round out the card-advantage layer.

The storm engine assembles via seven rituals (Brightstone, Battle Hymn, Pyretic, Rite of Flame, Seething Song, Mana Geyser, Jeska's Will), three mana rocks (Sol Ring, Ruby Medallion, Arcane Signet-adjacent slot via Birgi's +R-per-cast passive), and three storm-recursion enablers (Past in Flames, Underworld Breach, and Flashback the card — which targets any I/S in graveyard for flashback at mana cost). Bonus Round doubles every I/S cast for the rest of the turn, with Storm-Kiln Artist's Magecraft triggering on copy too — printing a Treasure on every copy as well as every cast.

Five win lines: (1) Storm kill via Grapeshot at storm 8+, often doubled by Bonus Round; (2) Empty the Warrens swing for 16-30 hasted goblins with Warchief/Chieftain anthems; (3) Snoop+Kiki+Impact Tremors infinite damage to each opponent (assembled via Goblin Recruiter stacking Kiki on top of library — Snoop in play then has Kiki's activated ability and loops); (4) Snoop+Kiki+Goblin Bombardment infinite single-target damage (alternate sac-output for the same combo); (5) Drain triggers — Pashalik + Impact Tremors + Boggart Shenanigans + Storm-Kiln Artist Treasures + Vivi's Persistence noncreature-spell ping = chip-and-burn that closes over 2-3 turns.

Bracket 3+ aggressive: 3 Game Changers (Gamble, Jeska's Will, Underworld Breach) all mono-R legal and within board exclusions (no Wheel of Fortune the card, no Grim Monolith / Mana Vault / Ancient Tomb / Mox Diamond). 8 interaction slots (Chaos Warp, Vandalblast, Bolt Bend, Deflecting Swat, Red Elemental Blast, Flaring Pain, Spinerock Tyrant as a second copy engine on top of Zada, Goblin Trashmaster cut to make room for the Gate 3 v3 revisions). Roaming Throne doubles Zada's trigger when naming Goblin — every Zada-targeted cantrip copies twice per other creature. The deck honors all 11 board-locked must-keeps (Krenko, Pashalik, Broadside Bombardiers, Snoop, Skirk Prospector, Roaming Throne, Brightstone Ritual, Empty the Warrens, Grapeshot, Skullclamp, Sol Ring) and Ruby Medallion.

highlights.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
highlights.reason: Commander — copies single-target instants/sorceries for each other creature you control. Turns 1-mana cantrips into N-card draw spells when the board is wide.

highlights.name: Conspicuous Snoop
highlights.reason: Combo centerpiece. With Kiki-Jiki on top of library (assembled via Goblin Recruiter), Snoop inherits Kiki's tap-copy ability — infinite hasted Snoop tokens. Also lets you cast goblins off the top of library.

highlights.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
highlights.reason: Combo piece for the Snoop loop. NOT a Game Changer (Snoop+Kiki is the canonical mono-R goblin combo, B3+ legal).

highlights.name: Goblin Recruiter
highlights.reason: Searches and stacks the top of library. The cleanest Snoop+Kiki assembly — Recruiter ETBs, you put Kiki on top, Snoop now has Kiki's ability. Also stacks Krenko/Pashalik/etc. for free Snoop casts.

highlights.name: Roaming Throne
highlights.reason: Naming Goblin doubles Zada's trigger — every cantrip on Zada makes two copies per other creature. Single most-impactful enchantment-doubler for the cantrip engine.

highlights.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
highlights.reason: +R per spell cast. With 8-15 spells in a combo turn this is 8-15 free mana, fueling the storm chain entirely on its own.

highlights.name: Storm-Kiln Artist
highlights.reason: Magecraft (triggers on cast OR copy) prints a Treasure per spell or Zada copy. With Bonus Round active, every spell + its copy makes 2 Treasures.

highlights.name: Underworld Breach
highlights.reason: GAME CHANGER. {1R} enchantment lets you escape every nonland I/S from yard. Recasts the entire storm chain after Past in Flames or Wheel-fill. Single most-explosive 2-mana spell in red storm.

highlights.name: Jeska's Will
highlights.reason: GAME CHANGER. {2R}: mode 1 = R per opp's hand-card (huge mid-game ramp), mode 2 = exile-top-3-play (impulse draw). With commander, do both. Often turns into 6-9 mana of acceleration.

highlights.name: Gamble
highlights.reason: GAME CHANGER. R tutor with random-discard cost. Always fetches the missing combo piece (Kiki, Snoop, Recruiter, Underworld Breach, Past in Flames).

highlights.name: Flashback
highlights.reason: R Instant — gives target I/S in your graveyard flashback for its mana cost. With Past in Flames or Naktamun Wheel in yard, this is a 1-mana 'recast my best spell from yard' effect. Adds a 4th recursion lane.

highlights.name: Bonus Round
highlights.reason: {1RR} sorcery doubles every I/S cast for rest of turn. With Storm-Kiln Artist Magecraft (triggers on copy) this also doubles Treasure output. Turns a 6-spell turn into 12-spell-equivalent storm count.

highlights.name: Goblin Bombardment
highlights.reason: Free repeatable sac outlet + ping. Adds a 4th kill line: Snoop+Kiki+Goblin Bombardment = infinite single-target damage by sacrificing the infinite Snoop tokens before EOT.

highlights.name: Bedlam Reveler
highlights.reason: {6RR} base, -1 per I/S in yard. Often costs {2R} in mid-game, ETB draws 3. Refills hand mid-storm-chain and is itself a 3/4 prowess body.

highlights.name: Spinerock Tyrant
highlights.reason: Second Zada-style copy engine. {3RR} 6/6 flying Dragon with wither. Whenever you cast a single-target I/S, may copy it with wither and new targets. Triggers on EVERY single-target spell (not just Zada-targeted), stacks on top of Zada's per-creature copies — every cantrip yields +1 extra copy.

highlights.name: Vivi's Persistence
highlights.reason: Creates a 0/1 Wizard token that deals 1 damage to each opp on each noncreature spell cast. In a 10-spell combo turn this drains 10 per opp. Plus returns from yard when commander enters or attacks.

highlights.name: Cavern of Souls
highlights.reason: Names Goblin: uncounterable Goblin spells + flexible color. Owned, slotted free.

winConditions.title: Storm Kill (Grapeshot)
cards: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
winConditions.description: Build storm count via Zada-target cantrip chain + rituals. At storm 8-15, Grapeshot deals 8-15 damage divided among any targets (8-15 to each opp lethals across the table). Bonus Round doubles every cast, halving the storm-spell requirement.

winConditions.title: Goblin Alpha Strike (Empty the Warrens)
winConditions.description: Empty the Warrens at storm 6+ creates 14+ goblin tokens. With Goblin Chieftain or Warchief providing haste, swing for 28+ damage in one untap. Krenko activation on a wide board often doubles the army.

winConditions.title: Snoop+Kiki+Impact Tremors (infinite damage)
winConditions.description: Combo assembly: Goblin Recruiter ETB → search library + put Kiki-Jiki on top. Snoop in play has Kiki's `{T}: hasted token copy` ability (because top of library is a Goblin card with that activated ability). Tap Snoop → hasted token Snoop; token also has Kiki's ability (top still Kiki) → infinite hasted Snoop ETBs. Each ETB triggers Impact Tremors for 1 damage to each opponent. Infinite damage to all opponents simultaneously.

winConditions.title: Snoop+Kiki+Goblin Bombardment (infinite single-target damage)
winConditions.description: Same Snoop+Kiki combo, alternate damage output. Each token Snoop is sacrificed to Goblin Bombardment for 1 damage to any target. Cleanly finishes a single high-life opponent or a planeswalker. Independent of Impact Tremors — second kill output of the same combo, providing combo redundancy.

winConditions.title: Drain Trigger Chip (multi-source)
winConditions.description: Pashalik (1 dmg per goblin death) + Impact Tremors (1 dmg per ETB) + Boggart (1 dmg per goblin death, single target) + Storm-Kiln Artist (Treasures fund more burn) + Vivi's Persistence (1 dmg per noncreature spell) + General Kreat (1 dmg per creature ETB). With a wide board + heavy spell density, these chip-then-burn 30-40 dmg over 2-3 turns.

synergies.title: Zada + Roaming Throne (trigger doubling)
synergies.description: Roaming Throne with Goblin chosen doubles Zada's trigger. Every Zada-targeted cantrip copies TWICE per other creature — 6 other creatures = 12 copies of a 1-mana cantrip. Massive card draw and storm count multiplier.

synergies.title: Zada + Ancestors' Aid (Treasure ramp)
synergies.description: Ancestors' Aid creates a Treasure as part of its effect, AND pumps the target creature. As a Zada copy, each copy creates a Treasure. With 5 other creatures, casting Ancestors' Aid on Zada produces 6 Treasures while pumping the whole team. Functionally a 2-mana Mana Geyser tied to your board.

synergies.title: Birgi + Storm Chain (perpetual ritual)
cards: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
synergies.description: Birgi adds R per spell cast. In a combo turn with 10-15 spells, Birgi alone produces 10-15 mana, effectively making every cantrip free. Stacks with rituals for explosive mana floors.

synergies.title: Storm-Kiln Artist + Bonus Round (double Treasures)
synergies.description: Storm-Kiln Artist's Magecraft triggers on both cast AND copy (verified oracle). Bonus Round doubles every spell. Result: each I/S in chain produces 2 Treasures. A 6-spell turn under Bonus Round = 12 Treasures, fueling infinite-storm continuation.

synergies.title: Past in Flames + Flashback the card (two-layer recursion)
synergies.description: Past in Flames flashbacks all I/S in yard for their mana cost. Flashback the card targets ONE I/S in yard and gives it flashback for its mana cost — but the key trick: cast Flashback targeting Past in Flames itself (now in yard after first cast). Flashback Past in Flames → all OTHER I/S get flashback. Effectively a 1-mana 'enable storm-chain reset' button.

synergies.title: Snoop + Goblin Recruiter (combo assembly)
synergies.description: Goblin Recruiter ETB searches library for any goblin cards and stacks them in any order on top. Put Kiki on top → Snoop now has Kiki's ability. Even without Kiki, can stack Pashalik / Krenko / Siege-Gang for free Snoop casts on subsequent turns.

synergies.title: Roaming Throne + General Kreat (doubled drain)
synergies.description: Roaming Throne (Goblin named) doubles General Kreat's `Whenever another creature you control enters, deal 1 damage to each opp` trigger. Every creature ETB now drains 2 per opp. With infinite Snoops from Kiki combo, this is yet another infinite-damage output.
